title: Insecure Deserialization
owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

levels.low: Binary object deserialization with no integrity or type verification. Callable stream references execute directly.
levels.medium: Custom object instantiator blocks direct system call references, but permits internal diagnostic gadget classes.
levels.high: Class allowlist checks prefix with a naive startswith match, allowing custom gadget names that share the trusted prefix.
levels.impossible: Strict primitive data parsing only. Dynamic type instantiation completely removed.

hints.low: Legacy protocols often specify callable references in serialized streams. How do binary stream opcodes reference functions?
hints.medium: The system inspects internal type declarations before restoring objects. Are any secondary diagnostic helper types allowed?
hints.high: The class validation routine checks only the prefix string of the type name. Can you craft a type name matching the prefix?
hints.impossible: Safe deserialization relies strictly on primitive data types and pre-defined schemas, never instantiating dynamic types from user input.
